notes.title: Publication of the game on IGDB!
notes.notes:
Hi, guys!

Well, a person from IGDB contacted me about publishing the game information on the IGDB website. And I asked what IGDB is, the answer was:

"IGDB is a database of games that any user can contribute to.
In addition to adding games, we add DLCs, updates and even forks and mods
Many things. And in addition to integrating the categories on Twitch, there are other sites that use the completely free API for the projects that people do."

I had to upload images of the game's brand and cover. And my game page was ready and if anyone wants to see more things on this site... Just go to their own site. =>.0=

Link: [url=https://www.igdb.com/games/j-and-the-sewer-world]https://www.igdb.com/games/j-and-the-sewer-world[/url]
